page.overview:
Who is Sanemi Shinazugawa?

Sanehiro Shinazugawa Unnamed Descendant}}

Sanemi is also the older brother of Genya Shinazugawa, a Demon Slayer who fought alongside Tanjiro Kamado and Nezuko Kamado.

Sanemi is a tall, very muscular young man with a light skin tone, and long, spiky, ruffled silver-white hair, featuring two large bangs on the left and middle side of his face, which he cuts short some time between the events of the Hashira meeting and the Mugen train incident. He has large almond-shaped eyes, long eyelashes. and small, pale purple irises with dark swirls, which turn bloodshot whenever he's angry. He also has dark patches beneath his eyes, making him appear perpetually tired or restless, giving him a crazed expression on his face.

Sanemi's appearance is notable for his many scars. A large, jagged scar runs across the upper right side of his forehead toward the center, accompanied by an X-shaped scar that cuts across his right temple and extends down through his right brow, lying just beneath the first. Another prominent, uneven scar goes over his right cheekbone and across the bridge of his nose — which came from an injury he sustained as a child when his transformed mother attacked him. He has another X-shaped scar on his chest, and a large, diagonal scar across his abdomen. He has four smaller scars on both his hands and forearms, which he sustained from past battles with demons.

Also known as: Sanemi, Wind Hashira.
